shared_elements: low-relief carved figure on a vertical stone slab
curvilinear incised detail on the body/garment
justification: Both surfaces show a single relief figure in profile occupying an upright panel, with an emphasised head ornament and incised curvilinear detailing, but that is about as generic as figural relief gets. B depicts a naturalistically proportioned standing human in a long pleated robe holding a spear and bow beneath a scale-pattern border, while A shows a squat, blocky composite creature with a large fanged/scrolled snout, volute and dot motifs and no held attributes or framing band; the conventions of proportion and detail are quite different.
